title: Boston Gas Company files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Hanscom Air Force Base.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Judith F. Judson. DTE 05-GC-6
